notes.title: Update 1.2.4 - Improved Combat AI
notes.content:
DevLog 1.2.4

[b][h1]NEW FEATURES/IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1][/b]

• New enemy added: Yellow Slime , which is a lightning elemental that can do an AOE damage and fires a lightning projectile
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/7a91010325cd9d3135a8a2e4ad60d69ce0286488.gif[/img]

•  Combat AI has been overhauled all across the board, and is prepped for new boss fights, and enemy types
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/2b5dce389f303d57e660bfa9b85c823c81b550a3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/32c466c73bc4aff5f2e489078212b00c4d86d142.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/3c17c6fec9a74e2647274bedc0b690c61e820e9e.gif[/img]

• Party Units while engaged in battle & there's an obstacle in between them and an enemy – will now pathfind to the enemy

• Ninja Warrior Party Units attack animation's have been improved

• Attack wind effect (trail renderer) for melee attacks has been improved

• Party units will now move randomly out of the way of player when in combat

• The timing for enemies/party units that fire projectiles has been greatly adjusted so the animation and projectiles are better synced

[b][h1]BUG FIXES:[/h1][/b]

• Fixed an issue where the combat system had some "break-points" for the enemy and the party (This is a complex thing to explain but the gist is they behave much better in multiple combat situations now)

• The formation/regroup will now work for all party units

notes.title: Update 1.2.3 - Pathfinding
notes.content:
[u]DevLog 1.2.3:[/u]

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/a4028c310eb448536af081bc04530b7a2a53ed47.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/01f812db2d8dc41856b5e7d99af54a9c616a4296.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/4092d2b8569122fb0ba840b08e9759dd8082f37d.gif[/img]

• Pathfinding added to the Party Units, when they go off screen they will pathfind to the player. Also auto teleporting to player is moved out a bit further as well to accommodate

• Formation/Regroup added to the party menu

• Introducing a new puzzle system starting with a tile-based puzzle that's easy to solve in the Ninja cave

•  New enemy variants for the vampire bat and spider have been added in the Ninja cave, this will make the grind a bit smoother in the Ninja prologue

[h1][b]BUG FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h1]

• Major fix where if you disabled the torch it would break map transitions

• Major fix for if you tried to talk to the dead clan leader the dialogue would freeze

• Ninja boss fight in cave has been improved with new animations and effects

• Ninja sword attack effects improved

notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - More bug fixes
notes.content:
DevLog 1.2.2:

BUG FIXES:

• Fixes to the tutorial system so it no longer conflicts with NPC dialogue, disables any nearby enemies, and closes off other maps until finished.

• Fixes to the way the Party Units move away from you on touch, they now properly animate when moving away from you and no longer look like a floating mannequin.

• Party Unit NPC's combat mode adjusted a bit so they should go after enemies a bit more and not stop as much

IMPROVEMENTS:

• Player mass is raised to 20 to make sure NPC's don't move the player around too aggressively

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
DevLog Update 1.2.1

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]:

• Ninja Power Bow and Arrow Animations finalized (for the most part)
• Loot notification container is now located in the bottom left corner of screen.
• Inventory now closes all tabs when you press escape or B on controller

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

• Map transitions now force the player to stop moving and disables pause at all transitions points now
• Fixed an issue where when leaving some areas of the Overworld map you wouldn't be able to pause
• Fixed a major issue where after attacking in any given direction then opening inventory would make the player attack in the last direction moved in inventory
• Fixed an issue with the Ninja prologue quest when you go to talk with wise master the items he gives you would magnet to you before dialogue was closed

notes.title: 1.1.8 Released
notes.content:
1.1.8 is here with more important UI fixes and balances to the game. We added 3 new and special items that have a 50% chance of dropping: Soul Essence, which gives the player +10 Health, Mana or Stamina when you kill an enemy. This should ease up the difficulty in the lower levels. A new theme has been added: purple and gold. The UI has been improved in several areas, most importantly the menus with lists will scroll when you highlight any button now.

[list]

[b]NEW ENEMY TYPES:[/b]

The Desert enemies are now complete.
The Jungle enemies are 50% complete.
The Volcanic enemies are now 25% complete.
The mesa, volcanic, and jungle will have plenty more enemies placed in the next update or two.
Along with the new enemies, comes new enemy types. The new enemy types can fire off 2-3 attacks if need be, and can fire elemental projectiles, and/or arrows . Additionally the enemy attacks will now random roll if the enemy attack pool max is set above 1. Lastly the damage random rolls as well (Min to maximum attack range for every damage type)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/71f909182570477e20de1b74523a16ad255ad3a4.png[/img]
Saber-tooth Lyger has been chosen for the Druid's official starter Party Unit, (will be replacing the default wolf)

Tents and Camps system reworked (Tent allows you to sleep anywhere there is not an enemy), (Camps regen combined with tent regen allows the player to fully regenerate quite fast now)

[u][b]Fixes/Improvements:[/b][/u]

• Combat system update #3 for enemies and party units
• Many map collision fixes
• Custom cursor added in game
• Combat system rework #3
• Tents now cost 500 Gold
• Command Scrolls now cost 200 gold for 5
• Experience gain is a bit more spaced out after level 10
• Crystal added to mining holes so the player can craft engineering items
• Dark Knight intro difficulty has been lowered by adding treasure chests that should help ease things a bit
• Dark Knight Lore props added in the (Dark Knight Castle 2)
• Added death animations for enemies that didn't have one
• Adjustments to player movement speed at very high levels
• After fighting an overworld encounter, when transitioning back to the overworld map, your speed is now properly set
• Some previously existing maps are now larger (Part 2)
• Fix for Ninja smoke bombs not stopping enemies
• Fix for Ninja gas bomb damage system
• Fix for Ninja Throwing knives not doing any damage and missing some animations
• 7 new enemies added + magical enemy types

notes.title: Working Hard for the Early Access Beta
notes.content:
As most of you are wondering, when will this game be released? Well as you should know making big RPGs is a lot of work and it can be hard to get it out. With early access beta there are rules to be followed to get it released by Valve. This process could take a couple days, even up to 2 weeks. 

We appreciate everyones understanding and your interest in playing this game. We will have the game ready ASAP! 

Thank You,

ShadowInk Designs Studio
